'''2008 Worlds Day 3 Michael Raveling DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Raveling]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 3). Sheet Sir Michael Raveling; title Like my LS I'm not Going. Objective Agents Of Black Sun as written Agents of the Black Sun.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Michael Raveling]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Agents Of Black Sun]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
